messages:
tessa (CS): drafting a 1-pager + 15min customer walkthrough for at-risk accounts. goal: clear, repeatable steps to reduce latency spikes and renewal friction. sharing draft checklist and runtime hints below — plz quick review.

rafi (ENG): nice. keep it super prescriptive. i recommend a 3-stage prime: quick-prefill, warm-run, smoke-check. small snippet to include for field teams.

rafi (ENG): ```
# field runtime suggestion (small/mid tenants)
runtime_config:
  cache_enabled: true
  cache_ttl_ms: 25000
  batching:
    max_batch: 12
    batch_ms: 10
  streaming: true
  fallback_policy: {type: "model-size", target: "quantized-small"}
# note: lower max_batch for interactive widgets
```

jordan (CS Ops): add the pre-warm playbook steps like this:
1) quick-prefill: push top-10 prompts once at 10 qps to seed prefix cache (~30s)
2) warm-run: run 200 synthetic sessions at 2 qps for 3 minutes to stabilize KV cache
3) smoke-check: capture lat_p50/95, cache_hit_rate, tokens_per_req, error_rate. attach traces.

lina (DE): decision helpers for the one-pager: "If cache_hit_rate < 25% -> ask for example prompt set and enable client-side prefill. If tokens_per_req > 400 -> recommend context trimming or ask ENG to propose a quantized variant." short and actionable.

ops-bot: reminder: attach last 5 warm-run traces and include the tenant id in the ticket before scheduling enablement call.

tessa (CS): customer script (15 min):
- 0:00-1:00: intro + expected outcomes (reduce p95 by X, stabilize cost)
- 1:00-6:00: demo cold vs warmed session (show side-by-side latency + tokencounts)
- 6:00-9:00: walk through recommended runtime snippet + pre-warm steps
- 9:00-12:00: review warm-run telemetry and highlight risk signals to monitor
- 12:00-14:30: propose immediate mitigations (enable streaming / reduce batch_ms / enable prefill)
- 14:30-15:00: next steps and handoff (owner, eng follow-up, checkin schedule)

rafi (ENG): add troubleshooting quick matrix to 1-pager: "p95 > 1s -> check batch_ms and streaming; cache_hit_rate < 10% -> inspect prompt variance and prefill; error_rate > 1% -> collect sample ids + escalate to eng-oncall."

jordan (CS Ops): telemetry keys we capture in the run: ["lat_p50","lat_p95","cache_hit_rate","tokens_per_req","batch_size_avg","error_rate","routes_fallbacked"]. also capture one sample request/response pair for any error.

lina (DE): UX nit: include a 1-line 'decision map' at top: "Low cache -> prefill; high tokens -> trim prompts or quantize; sustained errors -> onboard eng-oncall." keep it scannable.

tessa (CS): perfect. i'll convert to a printable one-pager and add a checkbox table for the enablement call: pre-warm done, traces attached, telemetry snapshot, mitigation agreed, eng owner assigned. i'll post PDF to the tenant ticket and ping product when it's ready.

ops-bot: scheduled reminder created: link to ticket and calendar invite for enablement call.

rafi (ENG): small add: safe rollback instruction: flip routing to fallback-policy for 12-24h and monitor cache_hit_rate + lat_p95; revert when stable.

jordan (CS Ops): thanks team. i'll run the warm-run template tomorrow and attach traces to the ticket for the Thu enablement call.

tessa (CS): thanks all ":thumbsup:" — will share final PDF by EOD.
